items.text: Explain what a Savings Plan is and how it differs from Reserved Instances
Describe the three types of Savings Plans and when to use each
Explain how Spot Instances work and the 2-minute interruption warning
Describe the three Spot interruption behaviors: Terminate, Stop, Hibernate
Explain what a Dedicated Host is and the BYOL use case
Distinguish between Dedicated Hosts and Dedicated Instances
Navigate to the Savings Plans console and view AWS recommendations
Calculate a per-hour commitment amount for a Savings Plan
Purchase (or simulate purchasing) a Savings Plan from the AWS Console
Use the AWS Pricing Calculator to compare On-Demand vs Savings Plan costs
View Spot pricing history in the EC2 console
Submit a Spot Instance request and monitor the request status
Match each of the 5 EC2 pricing models to their ideal use case in a scenario question
Correctly identify Spot Instances as the answer when 90% discount AND fault-tolerance are mentioned
Correctly identify Dedicated Hosts (not Dedicated Instances) for BYOL / per-core licensing scenarios
Identify Compute Savings Plans as the answer when coverage across EC2, Lambda, and Fargate is needed
Know the key numbers: Spot = 90% max discount, Savings Plans/RI = 72% max, Spot warning = 2 minutes
